SELECT e.event_content_id AS eventContentId, e.event_name AS title, e.event_start_date AS eventStartDate, e.event_end_date AS eventEndDate,
COALESCE(e.addr, e.event_place) AS addr, e.image_url AS imageUrl FROM favorite_event fe INNER JOIN event e ON fe.event_content_id = e.event_content_id WHERE fe.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fe.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
